gaps.title: Unexplored Application of Privacy Preserving on Healthcare Datasets
gaps.description: While Privacy Preserving and Healthcare Datasets are prominent in current literature, zero papers in the corpus have evaluated Privacy Preserving directly on Healthcare Datasets under Adversarial Attacks constraints.
gaps.hypothesis: Applying Privacy Preserving directly to Healthcare Datasets under Adversarial Attacks constraints will overcome the structural representation disconnect, achieving statistically significant error reduction over traditional baseline heuristics.

anchor_a.title: Seminal Formulation: Privacy Preserving
anchor_a.tldr: Introduces Privacy Preserving with strong empirical validation.

anchor_b.title: Empirical Evaluation on Healthcare Datasets
anchor_b.tldr: Highlights persistent degradation under Adversarial Attacks.
